13:02.race_name: Midnite Aint Your Grandads Bookie Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Impressive at Lingfield on debut last August (5f); open to improvement; strong claims
runners.name: Arlos Girl
runners.spotlight: Beat a next-time-out winner when easily landing a 5f fillies' novice at Lingfield on her debut 171 days ago; looked a useful prospect on that occasion and she looks the one to beat despite her penalty.

runners.comment: 14th foal with nine winning siblings; dam a useful 7f winner; a newcomer of note
runners.name: Blue Deveron
runners.spotlight: 7,000gns 2yo; 14th foal; closely related to two winners, half-brother to seven more including Lamar (6f-9.4f including AW/Listed; 108), Haddaf (5f-8.5f including AW/Listed; 101) and Cloudbreaker (7f 2yo, Listed-placed at 1m4f; 101); dam 7f 2yo winner (105); starts out in an uncompetitive race and his pedigree makes him of interest.

runners.comment: Two second-place finishes this winter, the latest over C&D; leading contender
runners.name: Von Trotter
runners.spotlight: Promising start to his career when second of ten at Newcastle (6f) in November; improved when a close second over C&D six weeks ago and although that form isn't especially strong, he still rates a leading contender in this field.

runners.comment: Exposed 15-race maiden; should run her race but vulnerable to improvers
runners.name: Filly Foden
runners.spotlight: Fully exposed after 15 starts; second or third on ten occasions, including both starts since joining Rod Millman; should run her race but vulnerable to anything progressive.

runners.comment: Modest form in two 6f runs this winter; dropping to 5f not enough to tempt
runners.name: Sirhana
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two 6f runs this winter; dropping to 5f not enough to tempt.

runners.comment: Showed speed before weakening in the final furlong on debut (5f); open to improvement
runners.name: Pure Passion
runners.owner: J W Parry And Mrs C Shekells
runners.spotlight: The bare form of her debut fourth at Chelmsford (5f; 40-1) can't be rated too highly but she did show some pace before weakening in the final furlong; open to improvement.

runners.comment: 12,500gns yearling; half-sister to a Listed winner out of a 5f AW winner; market to guide
runners.name: Skip To Victory
runners.owner: On Top Racing J T Elliott S Thomas
runners.spotlight: 12,500gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 5f/5.5f winner Rogue Enforcer (including France/Italian Listed; RPR 95); dam 5f AW winner (59), half-sister to 7f Group 2 winner Finjaan; market instructive.

13:32.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap

runners.comment: Down the field in four runs for new yard but this C&D winner drops in class; check betting
runners.name: Qazaq
runners.spotlight: Won his first three starts for Roger Varian, including a C&D handicap off a 14lb higher mark, but he failed to fire in 2025 and has finished down the field in four runs since joining Iain Jardine; now drops into a Class 5 and market support would pique interest.

runners.comment: Come up short in three runs since an easy Newcastle win last October; drops in class today
runners.name: Selection
runners.spotlight: Smooth win in a 1m handicap at Newcastle in October; respectable efforts in Class 4 events at Newcastle on her last two runs; respected back down in class.

runners.comment: Good effort to win over C&D six weeks ago; up 3lb but that formline is strong
runners.name: Hale End
runners.spotlight: Game effort to win a C&D handicap six weeks ago and a 3lb rise looks fair given the Topspeed figure and the subsequent wins of the second (twice), fourth, fifth and seventh; solid claims.

runners.comment: Four wins from last five starts, including C&D; may not have reached his ceiling just yet
runners.name: Tonal
runners.spotlight: Four wins (including over C&D) and a second from his last five starts; better than ever with a smooth Wolverhampton win four weeks ago; conditions to suit and another big run should be forthcoming.

runners.comment: Down the field in fillies' handicaps on her last two starts; could prove vulnerable again
runners.name: Beauty By My Side
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins, the latest at Chelmsford off 2lb lower last October; not so good twice since and could prove vulnerable back against male opposition.

runners.comment: Wins have come at 1m2f/1m4f but in good form over 1m since September; edging up weights
runners.name: Frostmagic
runners.spotlight: Two wins over further last summer; has run some good races over 1m at Kempton since September but he is edging up the weights and needs another step forward to win.

runners.comment: Steps back up in trip for his handicap debut; still has low mileage
runners.name: Thequietman
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden; he hasn't landed a blow in two 7f runs for new yard (after 440 days off) but he moves back up in trip for his handicap debut and still has low mileage.

runners.comment: Struggled since a wide-margin Class 6 win in November (1m2f); others appeal more
runners.name: Renesmee
runners.spotlight: Wide-margin win in Class 6 company in November (1m2f); not so good since and needs more to overcome this mark.

runners.comment: May come on for last month's stable/handicap debut after 402 days off but he needs to
runners.name: Cy Twombly
runners.spotlight: May come on for last month's stable/handicap debut after 402 days off but such progress is essential.

runners.comment: Running okay in defeat and his mark is easing; may need a drop in class though
runners.name: Packetofbiscuits
runners.owner: A Pot To Pete In Syndicate
runners.spotlight: He has run some fair races in defeat for his new stable and his mark continues to ease; may need a drop into Class 6 before he is of serious interest though.

runners.comment: Four 7f wins here and does stay this trip; best watched after nine months off though
runners.name: King Of York
runners.owner: A Baker D Slack M Wilson & Partners
runners.spotlight: His four wins have come here but over 7f; stays 1m but back from nine months off may not be the time to catch him.

runners.comment: 2-2 for new yard and still has plenty of handicapping scope; strong claims
runners.name: Betties Bay
runners.spotlight: Thrown in on her best form for Georgina Nicholls and she made it 2-2 for new connections with a Lingfield win that was more commanding than the winning distance might suggest; 1lb wrong under a penalty but surprising if there isn't a fair bit left in the tank.

runners.comment: Two 6f wins last month and turned in another solid effort over 5f here last week
runners.name: Twilight Madness
runners.owner: P R Hedger & P C F Racing Ltd
runners.spotlight: Two front-running 6f wins last month, beating Clover Time on the second occasion, and found only an in-form rival too strong here last week (5f); should remain competitive.

runners.comment: Ended losing run when beating Clover Time over C&D 17 days ago; 2lb rise looks manageable
runners.name: Good Earth
runners.spotlight: He had a couple of today's rivals in behind when getting up close home in a C&D handicap 17 days ago, ending a losing run in the process; a 2lb rise doesn't handicap him out of things.

runners.comment: Promise on 2yo debut; less good after a year off but faces more realistic challenge today
runners.name: Charging Bull
runners.spotlight: Promise on his 2yo debut but neither run back from a year off has been quite so encouraging; makes his handicap debut at a realistic level though and he is bred to be better than a Class 6 performer.

runners.comment: Penultimate C&D 4th was a fair run but not so good in Class 5 latest; more needed to win
runners.name: Camera Shy
runners.owner: The Horse Watchers 13 And Michael Dods
runners.spotlight: Fair fourth over C&D last month, his second run for new connections, but unable to build on it back here 24 days ago; edging down the weights and returns to Class 6 but he needs to pull out more.

runners.breeder: Miss S Sands & Mrs Lynette Andersen
runners.comment: Runner-up in all five AW runs, the latest over C&D; in the mix once again
runners.name: Clover Time
runners.spotlight: Banging at the door in AW handicaps, finishing second for the fifth start in succession when missing out by half a length over C&D 17 days ago; runs off the same mark and should make another bold bid.

runners.comment: Proving frustrating but conditions to suit and the headgear could give him a lift
runners.name: Minnesota Lad
runners.spotlight: Good second over C&D last month but not quite in the same form back here 17 days ago; likely to run his race and more minor money could be on the cards; cheekpieces now added.

runners.comment: Ten-race maiden but shown promise, including 6f on Tapeta; market useful on stable debut
runners.name: Northern Attitude
runners.spotlight: Still seeking her first success after ten starts but she showed promise in Ireland and again for Gemma Tutty in the second half of 2025; 6f on Tapeta no issue and she needs a market check starting out for Joey Ramsden (sold 7,500gns in November) after 113 days off.

runners.comment: On a losing run and the return of blinkers isn't enough to earn him the verdict
runners.name: Swiss Ace
runners.spotlight: Losing run stretches back to December 2023; not beaten far at Newcastle in November (7f) but that is flanked by lesser efforts; blinkers back on today but others appeal more.

runners.comment: Poor strike-rate; effective over C&D and on fair mark but needs to raise his game a notch
runners.name: Atomic Mass
runners.spotlight: Just one win from his 21 starts but he was twice a runner-up over C&D last autumn and he is now 4lb lower than for the second of those efforts; recent runs need bettering if he is to take this though.

runners.comment: Running well for new yard but this is stronger than the race in which he was 3rd last week
runners.name: Profit Street
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f 0-55 handicap at Wolverhampton last month on his fourth start for James Owen; four placed efforts have followed, the latest over C&D last week, but this is a deeper race and the stable looks to hold stronger claims with Betties Bay.

runners.breeder: D & S L Tanker Transport Ltd
runners.comment: Mixed record this winter; minor honour in a classified yesterday but looks vulnerable
runners.name: Tommytwohoots
runners.spotlight: Mixed record this winter and looks vulnerable in this field, even though yesterday's minor honour in a Chelmsford classified was one of the better efforts.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and on a good mark if able to get to the front early
runners.name: How Impressive
runners.spotlight: Fine second to an improving rival over C&D four weeks ago; disappointed at Lingfield ten days later when he was unable to get to the front; capable off this mark and a danger to all if securing the early lead.

runners.comment: Only 1lb higher than for his last win and returning to a Class 5 will help
runners.name: Blazing Son
runners.spotlight: Just 1lb higher than for his Newcastle win last September (7f) and he is fully effective at this track; drops back down into Class 5 company and couldn't discount.

runners.comment: Chasing a course hat-trick and last week's 6f win was a dominant one; respected
runners.name: Brazilian Rose
runners.spotlight: Three wins at Newcastle last January and she is back in the groove this month, winning over C&D four weeks ago and following up over 6f here last week; she has more on her plate back against male opposition but she is a strong traveller arriving in top form so can't be discounted.

runners.breeder: North Cheshire Trading And Storage Ltd
runners.comment: C&D winner; yet to win a handicap but he has threatened; headgear tried now down in class
runners.name: Grabajabba
runners.spotlight: One of his two wins in December 2024 came over C&D; yet to win a handicap but there have been some good runs along the way, including at Chelmsford last month; keeping on at Wolverhampton last time when getting no run up the far rail and that isn't the run to judge him on; drops to Class 5 with cheekpieces given a go.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo; not beaten far on recent handicap debut; open to further progress
runners.name: Lodge
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced filly; first and second in 6f events last summer and only beaten 2l into fifth on her recent handicap debut (7f, Tapeta); improvement needed to defy this mark but it's not out of the question.

runners.comment: Winless in 2025 but retained ability; sharper for recent run; interesting off reduced mark
runners.name: Mereside Diva
runners.spotlight: Lurks on a dangerous mark now and her recent return from a four-month break should have blown away any cobwebs; drops in class and could have a big part to play.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit but ended 2025 quietly; easy lead unlikely this time
runners.name: Federal Envoy
runners.owner: Lets Be Lucky Racing 37 & David Carroll
runners.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner; now 4lb lower than for the last success but he wasn't at his best in the second half of 2025; easy lead unlikely this time and others appeal more.

runners.comment: Two wins for C Fellowes in 2025; sold 20,000gns since last seen; still has some potential
runners.name: Saytarr
runners.spotlight: Won twice on AW (7f and 1m) for Charlie Fellowes last summer; ended that campaign with two lesser efforts before changing hands for 20,000gns in October; still has an air of unfinished business about him and he is an intriguing contender on his stable debut.

runners.breeder: D Farrington P Gately T Killarney
runners.comment: C&D winner; ended 2025 with a good 2nd at Brighton; returns from a break in a warm race
runners.name: Shaw Park
runners.spotlight: C&D win last March when rated 6lb lower; added a Yarmouth success in May and also ran well for second at Brighton (good record there) when last seen five months ago; whether he is well enough treated to win this on his return is a moot point.

runners.comment: Placed on his last two runs over this C&D, the latest last week; each-way claims again
runners.name: Chola Empire
runners.spotlight: Placed on his last two runs over C&D, the latest when third behind an improver last week; each-way claims once more.

runners.comment: C&D winner; mixed bag in handicaps last year but still has relatively low mileage
runners.name: Singoura
runners.spotlight: C&D win in a fillies' novice event in December 2024; didn't progress in handicaps last year but she returns from a five-month break off a reduced mark and can't be discounted.

runners.comment: Back to form when a front-running third at Newcastle two weeks ago; easy lead unlikely
runners.name: Express Train
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a 6f novice at Leicester last summer and a return to positive tactics saw him return to form when third at Newcastle two weeks ago (6f); P J McDonald replaces a 7lb claimer; easy lead seems unlikely in this field, however.

15:03.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap

runners.comment: Not as consistent as he was but this is a drop in class and he can't be discounted
runners.name: Willem Twee
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old but he ran well when third in a hot Newcastle handicap last May (6f; RPR 108) and he races off a 7lb lower mark today; neither subsequent run has been comparable but this is a drop in grade and he can't be ruled out.

runners.comment: On a dangerous mark but starts out for new yard after a year off; best form at 1m-1m2f
runners.name: Diderot
runners.spotlight: Smart handicapper at up to 1m2f when trained by James Ferguson; not at his best when last seen and he has a point to prove dropping in trip on his stable debut (same owners) after 357 days off.

runners.comment: Clear signs of a revival last time and on a dangerous mark if he can build on it
runners.name: Doctor Khan Junior
runners.spotlight: Hugely progressive in 2023/early 2024, winning six times; short of his best in two runs in 2025 but his latest close fourth at Kempton was a step back in the right direction; he will need another step forward to take this but it's not out of the question.

runners.comment: Five wins in productive 2025; this race demands more but it's not impossible; yard runs 2
runners.name: Legal Reform
runners.spotlight: Multiple C&D winner who won five handicaps in a productive 2025 campaign, the latest at Wolverhampton on Boxing Day; another career best will be required to defy a BHA mark that has crept into the 90s for the first time but he is seemingly better than ever; connections also run Down To The Kid.

runners.comment: Five wins at Newcastle but effective over C&D; not at best last time but can bounce back
runners.name: Eldrickjones
runners.spotlight: His five AW wins have all come at Newcastle but he has run well over C&D too; not handicapped out of things if bouncing back from a slightly disappointing effort at Newcastle seven weeks ago.

runners.breeder: Lynn Lodge Stud & Pier House Stud
runners.comment: Two fine runs this month, winning here and 2nd at Newcastle (both 1m); still on fair mark
runners.name: Talis Evolvere
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run when winning a 1m handicap here four weeks ago; similar form when second to a classy stablemate at Newcastle two weeks ago; still has handicapping scope.

runners.comment: Dropped right away on last month's stable debut; hood discarded; others look safer
runners.name: Gallant
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins (6f and 1m) when trained by Andrew Balding; dropped right away on his stable debut at Lingfield eight weeks ago and the hood he wore there is quickly dispensed with; others arrive with less to prove.

runners.comment: Not at best behind Legal Reform on Boxing Day; career best required to take this
runners.name: Flag Of St George
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who won two 7f turf handicaps last summer; close second at Lingfield (7f) on his penultimate start but his form dipped when fifth of six behind Legal Reform on Boxing Day; a personal best will be required to take this.

runners.comment: Chasing a C&D hat-trick and 2lb well in under a penalty; big player stepping up in class
runners.name: Down To The Kid
runners.spotlight: Revived by a drop back in distance, winning five times and finishing second on three occasions in ten runs at 7f-1m for current stable; impressive over C&D last week and he is 2lb well in under his penalty; this is a step up in class but still of some interest.

15:38.race_name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Down in the weights but little persuasive form since returning from a long absence in June
runners.name: Traila
runners.owner: Katy Jane Reed And Edward J Ware
runners.spotlight: Has been a useful handicapper in his time but he was pulled up lame at Newbury in August and then tailed off over 2m here last month; tumbling down the weights but comes with risk attached.

runners.comment: Hurdle win on stable debut last summer but not so good twice after; risky back on Flat
runners.name: Reina Del Mar
runners.spotlight: Three 1m4f wins on the Flat for Ed Walker; made a winning debut for Tim Vaughan over hurdles last summer but two subsequent runs (wind op before latest) haven't been so good; not sure what to expect back on the Flat.

runners.comment: 0-8 but went desperately close over 1m6f at Chelmsford last April; interesting after break
runners.name: Don Simon
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden but twice ran well on AW last spring, including a short-head defeat over 1m6f at Chelmsford; not quite so good twice afterwards but he returns from a break on a competitive mark and still has time to deliver an improved showing.

runners.comment: Expensive to follow but he has run into some useful opponents; up in trip for h'cap debut
runners.name: Military Cross
runners.spotlight: Chased home a better-fancied stablemate (who is now BHA rated 88) on his Kempton debut last September and then bumped into another smart sort at Ascot on his second run; his four subsequent defeats have come at odds of 30-100 (again behind a progressive rival), Evs, 8-11 and 6-4 and although he should stay this longer trip well, the fact more new headgear is tried suggests he has his quirks; still of interest on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Disappointing over 2m twice last month; new headgear; dangerous if back to his best
runners.name: Aajej
runners.spotlight: His first three attempts on AW were encouraging but he has been disappointing over 2m on his last two runs (visored latest); drops back in trip with blinkers given a go; well treated if back to his best.

runners.comment: Latest Chelmsford 3rd was better but he'll need to pull out more to win this stronger race
runners.name: Pleasant Man
runners.spotlight: Dropping down the weights for his new yard and his latest Chelmsford third was a bit more like it; that was in a Class 5, however, and he has more to do today.

runners.comment: 1m4f win last October and solid efforts on last two starts; more minor money on the cards
runners.name: Moon Sniper
runners.owner: C L A Edginton & A J Niven
runners.spotlight: Successful in a 1m4f handicap at Newcastle last autumn and there have been some good runs in defeat since, including over 1m4f here 17 days ago; well positioned in that steadily run race and more minor money perhaps his best hope.

runners.comment: Absent since a poor run in July; progressive beforehand and still has time on his side
runners.name: Trojan Soldier
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who finished second in his first two handicap runs, both on good ground on turf (1m2f and 1m4f); absent since a poor run at Ayr in July; still not fully exposed.

16:10.race_name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap

runners.comment: Easy win in a 1m4f handicap at Newcastle last week; could well have more to offer
runners.name: Time Turner
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt when running out the easy winner of a 1m4f handicap at Newcastle last week; 1lb well in under a penalty; good chance of following up.

runners.comment: Six-time AW winner; makes stable debut in a competitive race and others appeal more
runners.name: Rubellite
runners.spotlight: Six-time Tapeta winner, the latest for Richard Fahey last September when rated 4lb lower; starts out for a new stable (same owner) after 52 days off; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Course winner; good second-place finishes on last two starts; should be involved again
runners.name: Naughty Niall
runners.spotlight: 1m win here in December 2024 and added wins over 1m2f and 1m4f last year; runner-up on his last two starts and no obvious reason why he wouldn't go well again.

runners.comment: Made a winning stable debut at Chelmsford (1m2f) 3 weeks ago; form franked; should go well
runners.name: Beachborough Girl
runners.spotlight: 0-10 for Alice Haynes but she made a winning debut for her new yard when scoring at Chelmsford three weeks ago (1m2f); won that race with a bit more authority than the winning margin might indicate and the second (pair well clear) has won since; respected up 4lb.

runners.comment: Not lived up to market billing in either handicap run this month; may yet do better
runners.name: Saahir
runners.spotlight: Sent off favourite/joint favourite for two handicap starts this month but he has finished in midfield on both occasions; clearly felt capable of better but he needs to do it on the track and he will be another 2lb lower from the weekend.

runners.comment: Good second at Lingfield on Saturday (1m2f); still has low mileage; high on the list
runners.name: Rogue Identity
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race so far when second of nine in a Lingfield handicap on Saturday (1m2f; hooded for the first time); open to further progress after just six starts; high on the list.

runners.comment: Ready Kempton win latest (1m4f) in first-time cheekpieces; up 4lb and headgear now absent
runners.name: Sisterandbrother
runners.spotlight: Responded well to first-time cheekpieces when running out the ready winner of a 1m4f handicap at Kempton 16 days ago; up 4lb and the headgear is now discarded.

runners.comment: Poor form in maidens at up to 8.3f; more realistic task today and bred to do much better
runners.name: Velvet Red
runners.spotlight: Sent off at big prices and made little impact in three maiden runs at up to 8.3f; steps up in distance for her handicap debut and this 185,000euros purchase should be capable of better.

runners.comment: Well beaten in two runs for this yard; down 5lb but not easily recommended at present
runners.name: Shielas Well
runners.spotlight: Three wins (1m and 1m2f) for Grant Tuer; well beaten in two runs for her current stable and although she's dropped 5lb, she's not easy to support at the moment.

runners.comment: Promising 3rd over C&D on stable debut this month; 0-17 but holds each-way claims again
runners.name: Jack Andrea
runners.owner: J Rayment J Stephenson & R Eddery
runners.spotlight: 17-race maiden but he made an encouraging start for his new trainer when third in a 0-50 classified event over C&D 24 days ago; had a wide trip there and he should be capable of a prominent showing back in a handicap.

runners.comment: Effective over C&D but easy enough to take on at present
runners.name: Lawmans Blis
runners.spotlight: Outran his 66-1 odds when second in C&D classified event earlier in the month; well beaten in three runs since though and can't be recommended.

runners.comment: Poor form over 7f-1m; up in trip with a hood fitted but still easy enough to swerve
runners.name: Aye Up Tom
runners.spotlight: Poor form over 7f-1m, including dropped into a classified event three weeks ago; up in trip and hooded for the first time but too much to prove.

13:10.race_name: Racing To School Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (Go North Night Nurse Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Has shown enough on his two hurdle starts to suggest he could be involved today
runners.name: Belaya River
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden on the Flat and hasn't posed a serious threat on either hurdle start (2m/1m7f, good to soft; unraced on slower); however, he showed enough in those two contests to suggest he has a future in this code, and today's race looks to be less competitive; could be involved.

runners.comment: No impact when fourth on first two starts and pulled up at 80-1 at Wetherby last Thursday
runners.name: Big Love
runners.spotlight: No impact when fourth on first two starts and pulled up at 80-1 at Wetherby (2m, soft) last Thursday; he's hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Fifth at Musselburgh on second hurdle start and has each-way chance in a first-time hood
runners.name: Glenridding
runners.spotlight: Modest Flat winner who was about 2l behind Belaya River when fifth at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) last time on stable debut and second hurdle start; ran well on soft on the Flat; each-way chance in first-time hood.

runners.comment: Displayed ability on both Flat starts and not ruled out on hurdle/stable debut
runners.name: Hellion
runners.spotlight: Displayed ability when third in August/September on his two Flat starts for Brian Meehan (1m2f, good to soft); sold for 18,000gns in October; brings some potential to this hurdle and stable debut and he's not ruled out.

runners.comment: French Flat winner; new trainer does well with recruits from other stables; contender
runners.name: Shamsat
runners.spotlight: French Flat maiden winner (1m3f, heavy) who changed hands for 26,000euros in November; his new trainer does well with recruits from other stables and he could have a big part to play on hurdle debut.

runners.breeder: The Hon Mrs R Pease & Anthony Boswood
runners.comment: Big odds when tailed off/pulled up last month on his first two hurdle starts
runners.name: Some Boy Me
runners.spotlight: 0-5 on the Flat and big odds when tailed off/pulled up last month on his first two hurdle starts (good to soft/soft; C&D last time).

runners.comment: Third at Newbury on hurdle debut; top yard does very well at this course; leading claims
runners.name: Square dAlboni
runners.spotlight: 2yo Listed winner for Ralph Beckett who was 0-5 on the Flat last year; fairly encouraging start to hurdle career when third of 11 at 12-1 at Newbury (2m, good to soft) this month; open to improvement in this code and top trainer has 39% strike-rate here in last five seasons; leading claims.

runners.comment: Progressive handicapper on the Flat but very disappointing on his hurdle/stable debut
runners.name: Whatsgoingonmarvin
runners.spotlight: Progressive handicapper on the Flat for Sir Mark Prescott last year, with three wins (1m2f-1m6f, good-soft); following a 115,000gns sale he was very disappointing when 7-2 for last month's hurdle/stable debut at Kempton (2m, good); a transformation is needed today but he's not written off.

runners.comment: Didn't achieve much on the Flat and well beaten at 33-1 on hurdle debut at Musselburgh
runners.name: Blondina
runners.spotlight: 0-6 on the Flat and didn't achieve much; well beaten at 33-1 on hurdle/stable debut at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) and others are preferred.

runners.comment: Some ability on the Flat in France but 0-6 in that code; may be vulnerable on hurdle debut
runners.name: Prettylady
runners.spotlight: Displayed some ability on the Flat in France and she may make a hurdler; market check advised on stable debut but she was 0-6 in the other code and improvement is needed for the change of disciplines.

13:40.race_name: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Handicap Chase (Go North Monet's Garden Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Shaped as though he may have needed the run last time and he's not ruled out
runners.name: Dalyotin
runners.spotlight: 10yo who was pulled up over fences last May following a long absence and well beaten over hurdles at Carlisle in November; however, he ran well for a long way at Carlisle, shaping as though he may have needed the outing, and this five-time chase winner is not ruled out now back over fences.

runners.comment: Inconsistent but there have been some encouraging runs this term; could have part to play

runners.comment: Course winner who was a close third at Wetherby last Thursday and can be in the mix

runners.comment: Course chase winner who could build on November's comeback run over hurdles here

runners.comment: In good form over C&D on last two starts and a return to winning ways could be imminent
runners.name: Rebel Intentions

runners.name: Followango

runners.name: Moonlit Potter

runners.comment: Wandered and faded into third over 1m latest; drop to 7f and addition of blinkers may help
runners.name: My Shagaf
runners.spotlight: Wandered about a bit in front before fading into third on 1m Southwell handicap debut six weeks ago, so the addition of blinkers and drop back to 7f are possible positives this evening; won't need to raise her game much.

runners.comment: Made all in 6f turf novice in October but no joy in handicaps since; cheekpieces go on
runners.name: Fermain
runners.spotlight: Made all in 6f Leicester novice in October but no joy in four handicaps since, beaten over 7l into third when stepped up from 6f to 1m at Southwell 13 days ago; first-time cheekpieces are now added to the tongue-tie she wore at Southwell; yard won this last year.

runners.comment: Consistent since last summer, including two wins; fair fourth at Southwell (6f) last week
runners.name: Papa Cocktail
runners.spotlight: Generally consistent form (turf/AW) since last July features two wins; respectable fourth of ten over 6f at Southwell ten days ago and ought to be competitive again.

runners.comment: Three wins in 2025 and notched another this month; also good second at Kempton last week
runners.name: Em Four
runners.spotlight: Three wins in 2025 and added to his tally at Chelmsford (6f) at the beginning of this month; another good effort when second (Expert Agent fourth) at Kempton last week; unlikely to be far away.

runners.comment: Plenty to spare again at Southwell last week and can complete the hat-trick
runners.name: Sams Hope
runners.owner: D Morgan And K J Parris
runners.spotlight: Successful twice over C&D in the autumn and this thriving mare has also notched three Southwell wins since; had just over 3l to spare again there last week and looks well treated off 4lb higher today (due to be another 5lb higher from Saturday); can complete the hat-trick.

runners.comment: Two C&D wins last year, latterly in December; good second at Chelmsford latest
runners.name: Ziggys Queen
runners.spotlight: Won two C&D handicaps last year, latterly by a short head under Ethan Tindall in December; good second of ten at Chelmsford since and has claims if the outside stall isn't too big an inconvenience.

runners.comment: Six-time AW winner but recent efforts don't suggest he's likely to add to his tally today
runners.name: Fiscal Policy
runners.owner: S Thompson Mrs R Carr & G Shields
runners.spotlight: Six-time AW winner, including over C&D, but recent efforts don't obviously suggest he's in good enough form to take advantage of his reduced mark.

runners.comment: Down the field in three 7f runs for new yard; visored first time; plenty to prove
runners.name: Monotone
runners.spotlight: Down the field in three 7f runs for new stable; visored for first time now dropping back to 6f; has plenty to prove at present.

runners.comment: Second over 6f at Southwell under Jack Nicholls last time; same mark today
runners.name: Lovat Scout
runners.owner: D J Mackay & West Shaw Farm
runners.spotlight: Successful over 5f at Southwell in November and showed he's still equally effective at 6f when runner-up there off this mark 24 days ago, both under today's rider Jack Nicholls; another to consider.

runners.comment: 4lb below last win mark; caught the eye when running on for fourth at Kempton last week
runners.name: Expert Agent
runners.spotlight: Three-time Polytrack winner; now 4lb lower than when successful on turf last summer and caught the eye when running on from the rear for fourth (Em Four second) at Kempton (6f) last Wednesday; enters calculations.

runners.comment: Needs things to go right but two recent eyecatching C&D runs suggest he can win if they do
runners.name: Water Of Leith
runners.owner: Adam Mills And Jonnie Delta Racing
runners.spotlight: His style of racing leaves him a hostage to fortune but his last two efforts (both C&D) suggest he can capitalise on his reduced mark if things drop right; a must for the shortlist.
